scripts.format: prettier --write apps/web/src apps/web/*.js apps/web/*.ts playwright.config.ts package.json apps/web/package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/web/src apps/web/*.js apps/web/*.ts playwright.config.ts package.json apps/web/package.json
scripts.contract: cargo run -p knowtosay --bin export-openapi > apps/web/static/openapi.json && bunx openapi-typescript apps/web/static/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/lib/generated/api.ts
scripts.desktop: cd apps/api && bunx tauri dev --features desktop
scripts.desktop:build: cd apps/api && bunx tauri build --features desktop
